newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks mixed at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks mixed at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were mixed at the opening of trading on Monday following Friday's sharp losses as the bond market showed signs of stability and bargain-hunters stepped in.
In the first 15 minutes of trading, the Dow Jones industrial average was off 6.74 points at 8,024.48 after gaining 10 points at the opening. Advancing issues held a narrow lead over declines.

The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond, whose slide last week sparked Friday's 157-point plunge in the Dow, was up 9/32 of a point, or $2.81 per $1,000 face value, and its yield slipped to 6.61 percent from 6.64 percent on Friday.
The Nasdaq index was off 2.35 points at 1,596.17.
